selected_mechanisms.root_cause: deposit accepts msg.sender == SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS as co-equal caller; SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS is mutable storage updatable via updateSystemContractAddress (onlyFungible). If fungible module is compromised or any path influences SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS, any address equal to it can mint arbitrary tokens to any recipient.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Attacker controlling/influencing SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS (compromised fungible module / governance attack / update bug) calls deposit(self, largeAmount).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker gains control of SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS. 2. deposit(attacker, type(uint256).max). 3. _mint: _totalSupply += amount, _balances += amount. 4. Attacker holds inflated balance.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker receives minted tokens at no cost.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Mutable SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS widens the deposit trust boundary beyond the hardcoded FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS, a second less-hardened attack surface; source-evidenced; distinct authorization path.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: deposit has no upper bound on amount and no replay/dedup guard; a protocol-level replay of the same cross-chain event mints twice with no on-chain prevention.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Compromised/buggy system caller, or cross-chain replay triggers deposit twice for the same inbound tx.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. message replayed / system contract called twice for same tx. 2. deposit(to, amount) twice. 3. _mint twice — supply inflated by amount with no record of duplication.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Missing replay protection + missing mint cap are distinct from access control; affect _totalSupply independently of caller; triggerable even by a non-malicious buggy caller.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Decimal/precision normalization mismatch between foreign chain and ZEVM
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: _decimals set in constructor; deposit passes amount directly to _mint with no conversion; CHAIN_ID/CoinType unused in deposit.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether the cross-chain layer normalizes amounts before calling deposit, or this contract should — not in source.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: ZRC20 holders/protocol if over-minting; depositors if under-minting.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: deposit makes no external calls; only internal _mint.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: No external call, no reentrancy/DoS within deposit.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: Wrong lifecycle ordering as standalone bug in THIS contract
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: contract has no lifecycle/confirmation state; ordering is a property of the calling system, not this source.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Contract cannot enforce cross-chain ordering; covered under replay mechanism.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Arbitrary minted ZRC20 (potentially unbounded) if SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS controlled by attacker.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value correctness: ZRC20 supply should equal foreign asset locked; unbounded minting with mutable second caller violates the peg.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS path not admin-only (separate from fungible module, can be compromised independently); not dust (unbounded); not timing-only; not self-funded (minting free).
